question: Is it morally wrong to eat meat?

claims.text: Causing gratuitous suffering to animals is wrong across the traditions examined.
Whether eating meat as such is wrong turns on who counts morally and how much, on which the traditions disagree.

positions.position: ahimsa extends to all living beings; eating meat is a serious harm
what matters is the suffering involved; practices differ greatly in it
taking life is permitted within relations of reciprocity and gratitude
